SELECT r.recipe_code AS id, r.name, IFNULL(mc.name, '분류없음') AS category, r.category_id AS categoryId, r.sub_category_code AS subCategoryCode, r.instruction AS description, r.price, r.img_url AS image, r.is_active AS isActive, -- [수정] 원가를 동적으로 계산하는 서브쿼리 추가 (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(m.material_price * rd.required_qty), 0) FROM recipe_detail rd JOIN material m ON rd.material_code = m.material_code WHERE rd.recipe_code = r.recipe_code) AS cost FROM recipe r LEFT JOIN main_category mc ON r.category_id = mc.category_id ORDER BY r.recipe_code DESC

SELECT r.recipe_code, r.category_id, r.sub_category_code, r.name, r.instruction, r.price, r.img_url, r.is_active, r.cost, mc.name AS category, sc.name AS sub_category_name, rd.required_qty, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, m.material_price -- 이 부분 추가 FROM recipe r LEFT JOIN main_category mc ON r.category_id = mc.category_id LEFT JOIN sub_category sc ON r.sub_category_code = sc.sub_category_code LEFT JOIN recipe_detail rd ON r.recipe_code = rd.recipe_code LEFT JOIN material m ON rd.material_code = m.material_code WHERE r.recipe_code = #{id} ORDER BY rd.recipe_code, rd.material_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe (recipe_code, category_id, sub_category_code, name, price, cost, instruction, img_url, is_active) VALUES (#{id}, #{categoryId}, #{subCategoryCode}, #{name}, #{price}, #{cost}, #{instructions}, #{image}, #{isActive})
